replacement: Replace one head in concatenated attention-weighted values immediately before attention.dense; retain output projection bias and residual paths. Noop clones and reassigns the original head. Intervene at all 64 positions.
calibration: Unweighted mean of intact per-head value outputs across all 1024 input positions of the separate calibration book, including position zero; fixed across evaluation positions.
metric: Cross-entropy in nats at every position against the next token; mean over 16 equally sized blocks. Positive intervention-minus-intact means worse.
uncertainty: Descriptive block deltas, min/max and improved/harmed counts only. Consecutive blocks are dependent; no population confidence interval or significance claim.
scope: One small pretrained checkpoint, two short book excerpts, no held-out-from-pretraining claim; no novelty or universal head-function claim.
